ios.desc:
Transform your mindset with Delightful — the beautifully crafted gratitude journal that helps you focus on what matters most. Just 3 good things each day can measurably boost your happiness and well-being.

◆ COMPLETELY REIMAGINED FOR 2026

Delightful has been rebuilt from the ground up with powerful new features while keeping the simplicity you love.

◆ iCLOUD SYNC — YOUR JOURNAL, EVERYWHERE
Seamlessly sync your entire journal across iPhone, iPad, and all your Apple devices with iCloud. Your entries, photos, and favorites stay perfectly in sync — automatically and securely in your private iCloud account. Pick up right where you left off on any device.

◆ PHOTO JOURNALS — CAPTURE THE MOMENT
Attach photos to your gratitude entries using your camera or photo library. See your memories come alive with full-screen photo viewing and beautiful image previews right in your journal.

◆ HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Stay inspired without even opening the app:
▸ Daily Quote Widget — A fresh inspiring quote on your home screen every day
▸ Flashback Memory Widget — Rediscover past gratitude entries with "On This Day" memories and random journal flashbacks from your entire history

◆ 150 THOUGHTFUL PROMPTS
Never stare at a blank page. Choose from 150 curated prompts across 6 categories — Reflections, People & Things, Self & Growth, Nature & Everyday Moments, Challenges & Resilience, and Mindfulness & Presence. Manage and customize which prompts appear.

◆ STREAK TRACKING & STATS DASHBOARD
Build lasting habits with your daily streak counter. Tap to reveal your full stats dashboard — total entries, words written, current streak, and an interactive word cloud that visualizes your most-used gratitude themes. Tap any word to filter entries. Share your stats as a beautiful card.

◆ COLOR-CODED ENTRIES & FAVORITES
Organize your journal your way. Tag entries with 7 beautiful colors — Rose, Amber, Gold, Sage, Ocean, Lavender, and Berry. Mark your most meaningful moments with a heart to build a collection of your favorite memories. Filter to view only favorites.

◆ SHAREABLE GRATITUDE CARDS & LETTERS
Share your gratitude beautifully. Create stunning share cards in 5 designer styles — Warm, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, and Midnight. Or compose a personalized Gratitude Letter addressed to someone special. Perfect for spreading positivity.
